high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "navfome," posted 20 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The photo is set against a backdrop of a mountainous landscape during what seems to be either sunrise or sunset, as indicated by the soft pink and purple hues in the sky. In the foreground, there is a person wearing a green jacket with a hood. The person's face is obscured by a large, reflective hexagonal mirror held up in front of their head.
